asset: Hokkaido salmon-bearing wood-carved bear v21 real 3DCodeVerse GLB
reviewer: ChatGPT direct inspection of actual v20-v21 comparison and actual v21 4-view Blender Cycles renders; not AI-generated illustrations

bear_anatomy_and_silhouette.reason: Body is recognizably a quadruped bear, yet shoulders and legs are rigid and back has an artificial flat shell.

face_and_expression.reason: Smaller triangulated nose removes the v20 boar-like oval, and fewer pasted facial lines; ears and eyes still feel mechanically assembled.

salmon_shape_and_bite.reason: Even after fuller fish head and engraved gill, fish is a long flat plank directly in front of muzzle. Lower bite is still barely visible from front.

carving_detail_and_wood.reason: Scalloped repeating ripples reduced, but new sparse blade cuts are too weak against a featureless flat back shell; no convincing anatomical fur direction.

paws_and_limbs.reason: Embedded paw toes remain, but forelimbs and rear legs are too cylindrical and large; feet read as heavy boots.

multi_view_presentation.reason: Actual 1920 x 1440 four-view comparison sheet and authentic official-Harness GLB inspected, each asset SHA-256 recorded.

defects.finding: Front and three-quarter Cycles renders still show a broad fish floating across/under nose with insufficient upper-lower jaw enclosure.
defects.required_fix: Rebuild the bite as a single spatially coherent mouth with visible jaw silhouette from the front; validate by side and 3/4 actual GLB renders.

defects.finding: Long, almost flat fish with plank-like head and rectangular flank; fish eye and gill details barely read.
defects.required_fix: Curve fish centerline, add asymmetric dorsal-belly profile and prominent anatomical head/gill, eliminate obvious fin-plate intersections.

defects.finding: V21 removed uniform stamps but leaves large smooth flat shell on back, with sparse stray straight engravings.
defects.required_fix: Sculpt fur groups following shoulder-to-flank anatomy, not only random sparse surface cuts or material.

defects.finding: Leg cylinders still look like boots and feet have spherical toe clusters.
defects.required_fix: Reshape shoulders, wrists, paw pads as integrated anatomical slopes and carve knuckles in primary mesh.

improvement_tasks: Do NOT promote v21 to models/hokkaido-bear/latest; technically valid but visually failed.
V20-to-v21 improvement includes triangular nose and fewer glued lines, but more bland torso and unchanged fish/bite structure.
Use actual silhouette/sketch-lock of the bear jaw and non-straight fish before new wood material passes.
Avoid pixor candidate primitive base; its four-view look was more toy-like, not a valid quality improvement.
